description: Express API whose admin routes are guarded once for the whole group instead of per route: app.use("/api/admin", verifyToken, verifyAdmin) mounted on the prefix in server.js, and router.use(verifyToken, verifyAdmin) at the top of the orders router. The route lines carry no middleware of their own, so a check that only reads the route line would call them unguarded. VC085 must not fire
